evals.prompt: Run the exploratory CogWriter-style adaptation for the supplied writing assignment.
evals.expected_output: The run creates and revises a structured plan once, generates segments in parallel from the whole plan, length-reviews them, and leaves goals.md untouched.
expectations: Labels the condition as an adaptation rather than a reproduction.
Uses native subagents without nested codex exec calls.
Keeps the top-level order fixed and records it in the shared trace.
